Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps

plot_region_lines.Rd

Generates a predefined Pacific Ocean map with region boundaries and labels. The map type is specified by type, with each type corresponding to a particular combination of lines and text annotations.

Usage

plot_region_lines(
  type,
  colour1 = "red",
  colour2 = "blue",
  shading = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.2
)

Arguments

type

Character string indicating the map to produce. One of:

"wcpfc"

Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission Convention Area.

"wcpo_epo"

Western-Central Pacific Ocean and Eastern Pacific Ocean split, separated by the 150°W meridian.

"npo_spo"

North Pacific Ocean and South Pacific Ocean split, separated by the equator.

"nx_sx"

Northern and Southern regions within the WCPFC Convention Area, separated by the equator west of the WCPFC boundary.

"wcpfc_epo"

Overlay of the WCPFC Convention Area and the WCPO/EPO split. Colours can be customised using colour1 and colour2.

colour1

Colour used for the first region in map types that support colour customisation. Defaults to "red".

colour2

Colour used for the second region in map types that support colour customisation. Defaults to "blue".

shading

Logical. If TRUE, shade the region(s) relevant to type. Where a plot type shares one colour across multiple sub-regions (e.g. "nx_sx"), their union is shaded as a single area.

alpha

Shading transparency. Defaults to 0.2.

Value

A ggplot object showing the requested Pacific Ocean region map.

Examples

plot_region_lines("wcpfc")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

plot_region_lines("wcpo_epo")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

plot_region_lines("npo_spo")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

plot_region_lines("nx_sx")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

plot_region_lines("wcpfc_epo")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

# Custom colours
plot_region_lines("wcpfc_epo",
         colour1 = "darkorange",
         colour2 = "navy")
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default

# With shading
plot_region_lines("wcpfc", shading = TRUE)
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default
plot_region_lines("nx_sx", colour1 = "darkgreen", shading = TRUE)
#> Error in fun(colour1 = colour1, colour2 = colour2): argument "plot" is missing, with no default
